title: Install resolves a shared collection member against both ranges
summary: Re-installing a collection whose member another installed collection lists at a different range no longer refuses when one release satisfies both, such as ^1.2.0 and ^1.4.0. The request becomes the range both accept, the lock pins a release every holder accepts, and each holder's collection row follows a pin that moves. Ranges no release can satisfy together still refuse with IA-DIST-CONFLICT, naming the holders.
